subject: general
question:
How many squares are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44804d804d8187e6e81a506adb3db5f00516efabb06a47d1d3321af0ffaeb83a.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

First we will count all the small squares as: We get total = 9 squares

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd898a8e133f94f1ec505424d9dce78f287ed5f224a485380e02facde1cf2d5a.png] 

Then, we get one biggest square: Total = 1 square.

Again, we get more big squares as: Total = 4 squares

Thus, a total of 9 + 1 + 4 = 14 squares.

Hence, the correct answer is **"14"**.
